<teammate-message teammate_id="chirp-social-bar" color="green" summary="Social bar shipped both platforms, PR #58, live-validated">
Done. PR: https://github.com/pablof7z/chirp/pull/58 (branch chirp-social-bar). Chirp re-pinned to NMP origin/master 56e83d7ad0664ac45028637f34b78d2e29570c8c — zero API drift, full workspace `cargo test` green.

## Honest status: real, not stubbed
Counts genuinely render from live relay data on both platforms. I seeded an ephemeral `nak serve` relay with a root note (authored by the signed-in test account) plus 2 replies, 3 reactions, and 1 repost from four separate signed throwaway accounts — a real relay round trip, not synthetic view state. Screenshots (committed at docs/validation/social-bar/{ios,android}/home-feed-social-bar.png, also posted to chirp#32):
- iOS Simulator: row shows counts next to Reply/Repost/Love, no Zap button.
- Android Emulator: row shows "Reply 2 · React 3 · Repost 1", no Zap button.

## How the bindings were generated/wired
- Registry: crates/nmp-app-chirp/concept-reads.json (iOS, facade=ChirpApp) and crates/nmp-chirp-android-ffi/concept-reads.json (Android, facade=AppHandle), both declaring replies/reactions/reposts (no zaps).
- iOS: ran `nmp gen concept-reads --platform rust` (generates crates/nmp-app-chirp/src/concept_reads_generated.rs, a `#[uniffi::export] impl ChirpApp` slice) and `--platform swift` (Bridge/Generated/ConceptReads.generated.swift). Had to hand-patch one generated import line (`crate::facade::ChirpApp` → `crate::app::ChirpApp` — Chirp's facade lives in app.rs, not facade.rs). Added a hand-written generic `ChirpApp.findTypedProjectionPayload(frame:key:)` since concept reads ride the same generic push frame as everything else, not a separate transport. `Components/NoteSocialCounts.swift` claims the 3 reads per row via `.task(id: item.id)`, decodes on every pushed frame via a new `KernelHandle.conceptReadFrameReceived` Combine subject, releases on `.onDisappear`.
- Android: ran `--platform kotlin` cleanly (apps/android/.../uniffi/ConceptReads.generated.kt) but the Rust half had to be hand-authored (crates/nmp-chirp-android-ffi/src/uniffi_app_loop/concept_reads.rs) — AppHandle guards its NmpApp pointer behind `Session::with_app` (a UAF-prevention closure), which the codegen's direct-accessor emitter can't target. Matches the registry's declared shape exactly so the generated Kotlin wrapper works against it unmodified. `ui/NoteSocialCounts.kt` mirrors the iOS lifecycle via `LaunchedEffect`+`try/finally`.
- Both re-derive counts by scanning the SAME pushed frame for their own claimed projection_key — proven end-to-end in Rust tests (real actor, real ingest, real pushed-frame decode, not just the synchronous introspection accessor) on both platforms before I ever touched Swift/Kotlin.

## Zap removal
Deleted entirely, not stubbed: ZapAmountSheet.swift + its tests (iOS), the zapNote() dispatch stub in SocialActions.kt (Android), all onZap/PendingZap/zapNote call sites through HomeFeedView/ModularBlockView/NoteRowView/NoteActions, plus the now-dead nip57_zap_* error-toast mappings on both platforms and the dead NoteRelationCounts/RelationCount decode path (chirp#35 already dropped relation_counts from the wire; both platforms still carried permanently-nil dead types for it — removed).

## Re-pin fallout fixed
NMP's Compose/SwiftUI component registry moved crates/nmp-cli/registry → crates/nmp-component-registry/registry upstream. Android's ComponentVendorDriftGateTest caught it (env lookup crash → real byte-diff once path fixed). Re-vendored NostrAvatar/NostrProfileHost/ProfileWire/NostrProfileName/NostrNip05Badge against the new location; split the identicon algorithm into its own nmp.content.NostrIdenticon.kt file since the canonical file also carries a kotlinx.serialization ContentTreeWire mirror that collides with Chirp's own FlatBuffers-generated type of the same name in the same package.

## Validated
- `cargo test --workspace` (Chirp): green.
- iOS `test_sim` full XCTest suite incl. UI tests: 190 passed, 0 failed, 6 pre-existing skips.
- Android `:app:testDebugUnitTest` + `:app:assembleDebug`: green.
- Both platforms live on simulator/emulator against the seeded relay (screenshots above).

## NMP gaps filed (not patched)
- nostr-multi-platform#3004 — concept-reads codegen hardcodes `crate::facade` module path.
- nostr-multi-platform#3005 — concept-reads codegen has no closure/guarded-accessor mode (needed for Android's Session::with_app pattern).

PR #58 has the full description with all of the above.
</teammate-message>
